nodes.title: r4 latency baseline of record: end of child speech -> her reply audible p50 5,183 / p90 6,712 ms (n = 58 turns; evals/relational-human/first-sound.mjs, 3 parallel lessons x 20, local in-process server, production routing incl. STT taxila-live-transcribe, server prefetch OFF, own Neon branch, synthetic child speech, US container, 2026-10-10). Within 15 % of 6,070 (timeline, fixed 750 ms fake ASR). 0/58 <= 900 ms. Stage p50: final transcript 1,599; server 2,689 (classify 848, note wait 1,429, reply 2,629, stored 2,689); response -> first PCM 785.

r4 latency L1 arms, same harness and n (52-59 turns each, first-sound, prod routing, 2026-10-10, US container): prefetch on 4,630 / 6,580; + edgeTrim tail fix 4,164 / 5,354; + speculative Studio row 4,454 / 5,795; + EXACT speculation 4,413 / 5,788 (spec hits 36/52 vs 17/54); debounce 100 ms 4,185 / 5,915 (not kept). Run-to-run spread about +-250 ms (rewrites 11-21 per run). Bar p50 <= 3,000 / p90 <= 4,500 NOT met; 900 ms NOT met (0 of 400+ turns).

edgeTrim's tail rule held back the last 800 ms of ALL audio of part 0, so the first PCM byte waited ~250-350 ms past DragonHD's own first byte. Fixed (hold only the trailing quiet run): response -> first PCM p50 784 -> 408 ms (n = 59 -> 56, first-sound, 2026-10-10); warm-socket DragonHD first byte from the same host 413 ms SIN / 449 ms centralindia (n = 10 each, evals/latency/dhd-ttfb-region.mjs).

The r4-timeline preload omitted production's TAXILA_STT_MODEL=taxila-live-transcribe; on gpt-4o-transcribe the deltas arrive with the final, so the device prefetch fired on 0/37 turns. With live-transcribe the joined deltas are complete at p50 ~850 ms after speech end and equal the final on 110/110 turns (synthetic adult-like child voice), final at ~1,550 ms (2026-10-10).

L3 early distress read (predicate + distressCheck-shaped model call), evals/latency/l3-early-distress.mjs, 265 labelled distress lines + 100 plain hard negatives (evals/safety-robust, DEV data the predicate was tuned on), US container, 2026-10-10: grok-4-1-fast model read p50 480 / p90 585 ms, 0/365 within 300 ms; taxila-fast 1,154 / 1,473. Recall predicate-or-model 265/265 (not held out); false positives on plain negatives 3/100 (grok).

edgeTrim holds back only the quiet run after the last loud frame (<= MAX_TAIL_MS), never loud audio; same trim lengths (tests/r4-latency-edgetrim.test.mjs). Reverse if: a listener panel hears clipped sentence ends or a pop at part boundaries more often than on the old rule.

Speculative plans carry the Studio row of the piece already on screen (turn.js specPlan + studioSeam.peekFactsRow, read only, patch 02), the same row the real turn adds after its kernel; TAXILA_SPEC_STUDIO_ROW=off restores the old plan. Reverse if: a speculative reply is ever adopted with a row the real turn did not add (key parity test fails) or peekFactsRow is shown to mutate Studio state.

EXACT speculation (perceive.js rule 5, TAXILA_EXACT_SPEC, ships OFF): on the prefetch, the reply for the turn's own plan starts once classify (and on a non-answer the note) is in; adopted only by the exact reply key; never on a distress read or a content-filter block. Switch on when: the main session confirms 0 hot-lane 429s from it at prod load. Reverse if: adopted replies differ from what the turn would have written (key parity) or quota 429s rise.

TTS first sentence stays SHADOW only (TAXILA_TTS_FIRST_SENTENCE=shadow; default off): the lock is the instrument (s1 locks only when it fails no per-sentence guard, asks nothing, names no screen/UI part, and s1 + the pinned kit question passes every whole-turn guard; never on closing, safety, check-in, forget-after-safety, why, thinking, break or diagnostic turns). Live mode rejected on its numbers (rj-r4lat-first-sentence-live). Reverse if: the shadow shows >= 300 ms p50 gain after a guard or rewrite-rate change.

Tried: device prefetch debounce 100 ms instead of 250 (first-sound, n = 58, 2026-10-10). Broke nothing, but the prefetch fired only 210 ms sooner while sending 2.4 prefetches per turn (more model calls) and adoption fell to 47/58; reply audible 4,185 / 5,915 ms, within run-to-run noise of 250 ms. Kept 250 ms.

Reply audible p50 <= 3,000 is not reachable on this harness under today's rules: final transcript ~1,550 ms (900 ms VAD silence) + note (taxila-gpt6 ~1,370) or reply (taxila-fast ~1,300) + commit 50 + DragonHD 400 + 110 lead ~ 3,000 on a CLEAN speculation hit; misses and rewrites (25-35 % of turns) put the p50 at ~4,200-4,450. Needs one of: faster note and reply models (<= ~700 ms), fewer guard rewrites, a live first-sentence path, or committing on the stable partial (L3, owner + safety decision).

r4 latency AFTER of record: reply audible p50 4,238 / p90 5,718 ms (n = 117 turns, two runs, evals/relational-human/first-sound.mjs, prod routing incl. live-transcribe STT, TAXILA_TURN_PREFETCH=on, TAXILA_EXACT_SPEC=on, TAXILA_ACK_AT_MS=1000, edgeTrim fix, speculative Studio row; local in-process server, own Neon branch, synthetic child speech, US container, 2026-10-10) vs 5,183 / 6,712 before (n = 58). Echo audible p50 2,971 -> 2,285 (played, n = 10 -> 17). Speculation hits 85/117. Bars p50 <= 3,000 / p90 <= 4,500 and echo <= 1,500 NOT met; 900 ms NOT met (0/117).

ack-leak at the fixed echo instant (evals/relational-human/ack-leak.mjs, 70 answers per arm, 9 topics, seed 11, prefetch on, prod routing, US container, 2026-10-10): T=1200 gap 0.22 (governor refusals, 0 late) AUC 0.49, n=56 graded; T=1000 gap -0.09 AUC 0.58, n=48 graded, late 0 right / 1 wrong; T=850 gap 0.51 (late 3 right / 21 wrong) AUC 0.57, n=53. T=1000 holds both bars; 850 leaks the verdict.

Tried (shadow): speaking the reply's first sentence as soon as it locks, before the rest of the turn is guarded/rewritten and committed. Measured on 117 turns (2026-10-10): s1 locks on 53/117, 44 of them speculation hits already final; only 2 of 34 rewrite turns can lock under safety-preserving rules (closing, check-in, why, thinking and teaching-without-a-pinned-question turns never lock). Estimated gain p50 57 ms (4,238 -> 4,235). Not built live: the client restructure and the unstored-s1-on-409 edge cost more than it buys. Re-measure with the shadow if the guard rewrite rate or the lock rules change.

Recommend TAXILA_ACK_AT_MS=1000 (code default stays 1200 until the main session switches it): holds the ack-leak bars at n = 48 graded (gap -0.09, AUC 0.58); -200 ms on every echo. Reverse / re-tune if: the classify deployment, its hedge or prod load changes (re-run ack-leak), or gap > 0.15 / AUC > 0.65 at n >= 40 graded.

Tap-to-talk page clock (tests/prod/r4-timeline on a local production build, prod routing, fake 750 ms commit->final, synthesised child clip, Done at +700 ms, class 7, n = 12 per arm, 2026-10-10): reply audible p50 5,005 (prefetch 0/12, turn-ack 0/12) -> 4,392 (Done tap sends the prefetch) -> 3,452 ms (the press also reopens the echo's turn: turn-ack 12/12, 2 echoes on graded answers). Indicative (small n). gpt-live-transcribe in push-to-talk streams the words before the commit 8/8 (last delta +711, final +1,286 ms, evals/latency/ptt-deltas.mjs).

On tap-to-talk the Done tap sends the turn prefetch (cascadeLink.talkEnd -> TurnPrefetcher.onQuiet, WebRTC transport only) and the press reopens the echo's turn (talkStart -> AckClient.onSpeech), as hands-free already did. Every echo rule stays server-side. Reverse if: tap-to-talk prefetches are adopted on < 50 % of turns on prod (wasted model calls) or the echo is heard on a non-graded or safety turn.

WITHDRAWN (harness fault, traced by stream 4B): the hands-free mid-utterance commits and truncated words seen on the r4-timeline page clock came from the FAKE transcriber, whose finish() finalised the item at the engine 150 ms micro-commit probe. The real gpt-live-transcribe opens a new item after a client commit (205/206 recorded). With 4B patch 01 to driver.mjs, 0/18 turns were truncated. Re-measure hands-free once base carries the patch.

UNDERSTAND-note bake-off, Azure Direct arms never measured before (evals/latency/note-bakeoff.mjs, the 355-case battery of record, policy-move scoring, US container, concurrency 4, 2026-10-10): gpt-6-sol (control) 330/355, distress 9/10, p50/p90 1,542/1,870 ms; gpt-6.1-sol 333/355, 2,101/2,780; gpt-6-astra 335/355, 2,364/3,485; deepseek-v4-flash 163/355 (172 errors), 0/10 distress; kimi-2.6 unusable (353 errors). None faster at gpt-6-sol accuracy; the note stays.

Tried: reply lane on taxila-gpt6-luna instead of taxila-fast (first-sound, AFTER config, interleaved runs, n = 120 vs 113, 2026-10-10). Reply audible p50 3,789 vs 4,006 ms: -217 [95% CI -580, +101], p90 -108 [-836, +660]; rewritten turns 29/120 vs 25/113 (the hoped-for fewer rewrites did not show); script guard 9 vs 3. Luna is also the whiteboard planner deployment (w2f-luna-reserved-for-whiteboard). Kept taxila-fast. Revisit if a luna-class model shows a CI-excluding-zero gain at n >= 100 with no guard increase.

Root cause of the full-suite-only test failures (p4-content-seam host-graded event, p2-face-player re-anchor cuts): tests/index.js runs every *.test.mjs in ONE node:test process, so module state is shared and a root-level before()/after() holds for the whole run (an import-time/root _setDeps replaced another file seam fakes; two root performance.now pins froze each other). Not load. Five files in one process: 2 fails before, 0 after (3/3). Fix 031724d3: install and restore per test body. Rule: never stub shared module state or globals at import time or in a root hook.

Every turn that sets distress records which stage set it (classify_model, predicate, content_filter, understand_note, duplex_pending, relational_floor; episode_open / unattributed for a safeguard move with none) on the [lesson] turn log line and in debug.distress, codes only; a kind that is not a code is reported as other (server/brain/turn.js distressOf, tests/r4-latency-distress-source.test.mjs). Reverse if: never; extend the code list when a new stage can set distress.

Tap-to-talk page clock at n = 48 (tests/prod/r4-timeline, local production build, fixed 750 ms fake ASR, synthesised clip, plain account class 7, Done 0.7 s after speech, every after flag on, merged tree 620a0a0e, headless Chromium in a US cloud container, 2026-10-10): reply audible p50 4,477 / p90 5,885 ms; prefetch 48/48; echo asked 48/48, granted 5 (all not_yet). Final transcript to turn POST p50 259 / p90 731 ms (min 178). Puppet face A/B, n = 12 each, fresh driver: TAXILA_FACE_PUPPET2D=0 gives 8-29 ms, puppet on gives 78-521 ms. The puppet main-thread work delays the turn POST (headless software rendering; not yet measured on a phone).

The puppet face delays the tap-to-talk turn POST by ~200-500 ms after the final transcript in headless Chromium (n = 12 vs 12, puppet on/off). Owner: stream 5 (src/face-puppet). Next: profile on a real low-end phone; if it holds, send the turn before the frame work (or yield).

Before a turn fetch the outbox makes one IndexedDB round trip, not three. reserve() reads the store once per lesson per page (a failed read is retried); the inflight status write goes out with the request and is awaited before the delete. The durable queued write still precedes the send. Measured with the puppet on (tap-to-talk page clock, headless, long-task observer): final to POST p50/p90 477/792 ms (n = 12) to 61/154 ms (n = 24). Reverse if: a reader of the stored inflight status appears, or a lost/duplicated turn is traced to it.
